title: ConvNeXt
description: Meta's ConvNeXt (Liu et al. 2022; tiny, small, base, large; ImageNet-1k, and ImageNet-22k fine-tuned at 224 and 384): a convolutional classifier of 7x7 depthwise convolutions,…
html:
Meta's ConvNeXt (Liu et al. 2022; tiny, small, base, large; ImageNet-1k, and ImageNet-22k fine-tuned at 224 and 384): a convolutional classifier of 7x7 depthwise convolutions, LayerNorm and MLP blocks. Apache-2.0.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: A ConvNet for the 2020s, CVPR 2022, 2022-01-10
  • Original code: https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models at 0df212b369a5
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/facebookresearch/ConvNeXt (PyTorch): timm ships a maintained re-implementation with the same Meta ImageNet-1k/22k weights and a uniform API.
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files:
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/timm/convnext_base.fb_in22k_ft_in1k/blob/67758fcbcf9f007ec7630bf8636b74a8f24e52a0/README.md
  • Training data: ImageNet-21k / ImageNet-22k (full ImageNet, fall 2011 release), ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification)
    • convnext_tiny.fb_in1k: ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification)
    • convnext_small.fb_in1k: ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification)
    • convnext_base.fb_in1k: ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification)
    • convnext_large.fb_in1k: ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification)
  • Kernel libraries: fvm_conv, fvm_seg
  • Variants: convnext_tiny.fb_in1k, convnext_small.fb_in1k, convnext_base.fb_in1k, convnext_large.fb_in1k, convnext_tiny.fb_in22k_ft_in1k, convnext_small.fb_in22k_ft_in1k, convnext_base.fb_in22k_ft_in1k (default of convnext_base), convnext_large.fb_in22k_ft_in1k (default of convnext_large), convnext_tiny.fb_in22k_ft_in1k_384, convnext_small.fb_in22k_ft_in1k_384, convnext_base.fb_in22k_ft_in1k_384, convnext_large.fb_in22k_ft_in1k_384
